title: Maine · Lobster Harbor Gangs
subtitle: Each color marks one fisher's territory. Cut another gang's traps and the sanction escalates: warning → severed buoy line → exclusion from the harbor. Documented since the 1880s.
imageAlt: Seven uniquely colored lobster trap buoys hanging on a weathered grey shingle wall — each color a different fisher's identity.
